Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Lateral control shown as active but no torque delivered; the vehicle is not steered.

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Torque stops mid-curve or mid-manoeuvre while still commanded, without a take-over warning.

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Torque applied while not engaged or after disengagement (HE-01.4).

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Torque request frozen at its last value; steering bias continues while the road changes (HE-02.3). Bounded by the envelope and EPS authority.

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Torque magnitude or rate above the intended value.

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Torque below the intended value: the vehicle understeers in a curve.

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Assisted lane change starts before the driver confirms (nudge) or before the target lane is clear.

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Correction arrives after the lane geometry required it; same vehicle response as delayed function.

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Torque held for less time than commanded; same vehicle response as stops functioning.

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Torque continues after the command ends (after lane change or disengagement); same as unrequested torque.

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Lateral response latency beyond specification; lane departure in curves.

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Torque in the opposite direction to the command.

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Oscillating or chattering torque; weaving within or out of the lane.

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Asymmetric authority left vs right; the excess side behaves as excessive function.

Hazard: H-06 Unannounced loss of longitudinal deceleration
Rationale: No deceleration delivered when following a lead that slows, without warning.

Hazard: H-06 Unannounced loss of longitudinal deceleration
Rationale: Deceleration stops while still needed (e.g. stale plan holds zero acceleration, HE-06.1).

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Braking with no reason (phantom braking), incl. a stop from speed. Unrequested acceleration has the same root but a different effect and is rated under M05.

Hazard: H-03 Unintended acceleration
Rationale: Acceleration request frozen at a positive value while the lead slows or stops.

Hazard: H-03 Unintended acceleration
Rationale: Acceleration above intended, or acceleration from standstill when not intended (HE-03.x). Also acceleration while not engaged, including just after a brake press has cancelled engagement (OS-13, HE-03.7, DQ-364).

Hazard: H-06 Unannounced loss of longitudinal deceleration
Rationale: Deceleration below the required value when closing on a lead.

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Braking before there is a reason; same response as unrequested braking.

Hazard: H-06 Unannounced loss of longitudinal deceleration
Rationale: Braking starts after it was needed; same as delayed.

Hazard: H-06 Unannounced loss of longitudinal deceleration
Rationale: Braking released before the vehicle has slowed enough; same as stops functioning.

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Braking continues after the reason has gone; vehicle slows or stops unexpectedly in traffic.

Hazard: H-06 Unannounced loss of longitudinal deceleration
Rationale: Longitudinal response latency beyond specification when the lead slows.

Hazard: H-03 Unintended acceleration
Rationale: Acceleration when deceleration is commanded (e.g. sign error), HE-03.3.

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Oscillating acceleration and braking (surging); unexpected decelerations for following traffic.
Longitudinal output is a single scalar request to the PCM; no left/right or per-axle asymmetry exists at this interface.

Hazard: H-05 Driver unable to override or disengage
Rationale: Disengagement on brake, cancel or override does not happen (HE-05.x). Engagement failing to happen is safe (driver drives).

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: System disengages while the driver relies on it, without adequate warning (lateral and longitudinal lost).

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Engagement without a driver request (the envelope gates on the PCM cruise rising edge); unexpected steering and acceleration. Lateral is the worst case and is rated here; the acceleration of a false engagement is rated as F-02 M05 in OS-13 (HE-03.7, DQ-364).

Hazard: H-05 Driver unable to override or disengage
Rationale: Engagement state stuck at 'engaged'; same as disengagement not happening.
Engagement is a discrete state; no magnitude.

Hazard: H-05 Driver unable to override or disengage
Rationale: Partial disengagement: one axis released, the other still actuating after brake or cancel.
Early disengagement equals an announced disengagement; rated under M02 if unannounced.

Hazard: H-05 Driver unable to override or disengage
Rationale: Disengagement after the driver input has passed; same as delayed.
Engagement has no commanded duration.

Hazard: H-05 Driver unable to override or disengage
Rationale: Engagement continues after the driver ends it; same as no disengagement.

Hazard: H-05 Driver unable to override or disengage
Rationale: Release delayed beyond the specified time after brake or cancel (SG-05 FTTI 0.2 s).

Hazard: H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion
Rationale: Engages when the driver cancels; same as unrequested engagement.

Hazard: H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Rationale: Repeated engage/disengage toggling; each drop behaves as an unannounced disengagement.
No asymmetric profile for a discrete state.

Hazard: H-09 Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not responding
Rationale: Inattention or unresponsiveness not detected, or no escalation to the no-response reaction (forced deceleration, lockout): the item keeps controlling the vehicle with nobody supervising (H-09, DQ-205). While the driver supervises it is latent (S0 rows): it removes a measure the controllability of H-02/H-06 relies on.

Hazard: H-09 Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not responding
Rationale: Monitoring stops during the drive; same as no function.

Hazard: H-09 Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not responding
Rationale: Attention estimate stuck: stuck 'attentive' is the same as no function; stuck 'distracted' is rated as M03.

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Over-sensitive DM: escalation and forced deceleration too often; same response as unrequested intervention.

Hazard: H-09 Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not responding
Rationale: Under-sensitive DM: a non-supervising driver is not detected; same as no function.

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Escalation steps reached too early; ends in unrequested forced deceleration.

Hazard: H-09 Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not responding
Rationale: Escalation too late: the item keeps driving unsupervised for longer; same as no function.
Alerts have no safety-relevant commanded duration.
Alert or lockout lasts longer than needed: availability only.

Rationale: Delayed detection; same as no function.

Rationale: Relay or forwarding blocks, delays or alters camera PCS/AEB messages, or the item transmits on PCS IDs (GAP-42).

Rationale: Envelope stuck in a blocking state (e.g. controls_allowed stuck false, relay stuck) while the SoC shows engaged: lateral and longitudinal silently dropped.

Hazard: H-10 Vehicle does not stop for a traffic signal or stop sign it is expected to stop for
Rationale: Does not stop for a red light or stop sign that Experimental Mode is presented as handling.

Hazard: H-10 Vehicle does not stop for a traffic signal or stop sign it is expected to stop for
Rationale: Starts stopping, then releases before the stop line; same as not stopping.

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Stops for a signal, sign, shadow or object that is not there (false stop).
Stuck model acceleration: the planner takes the minimum of model and MPC, so a stuck model value can only hold or reduce speed; rated as M03 if it brakes.

Hazard: H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration
Rationale: Excessive model deceleration; same as false stop.

Hazard: H-10 Vehicle does not stop for a traffic signal or stop sign it is expected to stop for
